description:
## Goal

Implement the Qdrant-backed index per the research spec. Indexers consume tool manifests (from `/api/v1/tools`), CLI introspect outputs (via the `cli-conversational-agent-inbox-client`), and widget extraction outputs (from `widget-static-extraction-indexer`). Unified descriptor payload across all three.

## Expected Work

- Index initialization + schema per research.
- Three indexers (one per surface type), each producing the shared descriptor payload.
- Query API (used by agent-led meta-tools and the passive track).
- Re-index triggers from research.
- Observability: latency metrics, index size, recall@K evaluation hook.

## Acceptance

- All three surface types ingest correctly.
- Query API meets the latency budget from research.
- Eval harness (separate item) can run against it.
name: agent-inbox-qdrant-retrieval-index
title: Build the unified Qdrant retrieval index in agent-inbox
